title: யார் கோடீஸ்வரன் - தீவிர பணவரவு யோகம் (Millionaire Wealth Yoga)
description: 2nd and 11th lords possessing high Sthana Balam (Exalted/Own), in mutual conjunction, trine (1-5-9), or aspect, indicates birth in wealthy family or becoming wealthy in their Dasa/Bhukti.

title: பணக்கஷ்டம் மற்றும் பொருளாதார நெருக்கடி (Financial Strain & Crunch)
description: 2nd and 11th lords debilitated or in 6, 8, 12 mutual relationship from Dasa Lagna leads to financial crises, debt accumulation, and loss of prestige.

title: கடன் எப்போது தீரும்? (Debt Resolution Timing)
description: Debt begins when Dasa Lord's dispositor connects with 6th lord and Ketu. In any Dasa where the dispositor is free from 6th lord and Ketu, the debts get cleared completely.

title: 8-ம் இடம் தரும் தீவிர அதிர்ஷ்டம் (Sudden Windfall / Lottery / Secret Wealth)
description: 8th house with high planetary strength confers unexpected wealth, lottery gains, stock market surges, unearned income, and treasure.
